race.comment: HURRICANE BERT (2) was a (22.62) winner last time out at Geelong from Box 7. Comes through a solid form race last start. Hard to fault his recent form and can win again. AMRON TOMMY (8) was big odds last time but gave a huge sight after a fast early split, weakening late to finish a 3.5 lengths fourth (28.13) over 500m at Bendigo. Bold showing expected. RUPEE ACTION (4) was safely held in tougher company last start after losing his position early at Bendigo, but prior to that won by half a length at Bendigo (24.14) beating PELICAN'S SUNDAY in a Grade 5 on October 21. Expected to feature in the finish. LILLYVALE LAD (3) scored in impressive time last start. Among the hopes. Something for the Multiples: PELICAN'S SUNDAY (6)
